title: Courtyard's Most Wanted: The Six Star Chase
summary: Get ready for Courtyard’s Most Wanted: a 10-day, multi-category collectibles drop building to November 19. Sign up to get notified before packs drop.
body_markdown:
The wait is almost over. On November 19th, fans of what is arguably the most popular video game of all time finally get a new installment 13 years in the making. It’s time to take over Leonida.


Doing so is going to come at the cost of a whole lot of stars.


As the world prepares to max out the six-star wanted system,[Courtyard](http://www.courtyard.io/) is introducing an intensity level of its own. Get ready for[Courtyard’s Most Wanted](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) .


While we can’t reveal everything about the collectible–and-bounty-filled event just yet, we’ve got a primer ready for you so you can hit the streets running.


## **What is Courtyard’s Most Wanted?**


[Courtyard’s Most Wanted](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) is a special event timed to nod to one of the most anticipated entertainment launches of the decade, and a chance for the Courtyard community to come together around the sights, sounds, and cultural zeitgeist of the game.


The event itself will run from Monday, November 9th until Wednesday, November 18th, with plenty of surprises to unpack. Think high stakes, big bounties, and the kind of once-in-a-lifetime pulls that collectors of[TCG](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pkmn) ,[sports cards](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=sports) ,[watches](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=watches) ,[coins](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=coins) and[sneakers](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=sneakers) will talk about for years.


## **Why November 19th is Such a Big Moment for Collectors**


Few releases shake up pop culture quite like the open world, dark humor, iconic soundtracks, and debauchery of one of gaming’s most legendary franchises. For more than two decades, it’s built a loyal, passionate fanbase, and the buildup to this launch, which comes 13 years after the previous edition, has been unlike anything gaming has ever seen.


Collectors know that kind of energy rarely stays in one corner of the Internet. Major cultural moments tend to spill over into the broader collectibles world, shaping what people talk about, chase, and want to own.[Courtyard’s Most Wanted](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) was built to give collectors access to the hype, joining in on the cultural crossover that is sure to dominate pop culture news for months to come.


## **How to Take Part in Courtyard’s Most Wanted Event**


There are two things you can do to ensure you won’t miss a thing when[Courtyard’s Most Wanted](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) event kicks off on November 9th:


### **Sign up to be notified**


Head to[the Courtyard Most Wanted event page](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) and click the blue "Notify Me" button to receive updates when the event goes live.


### **Follow Courtyard on social media**


We’ll be sharing teasers, sneak peeks, and announcements across our channels in the days ahead. Following us on[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtyard.io/) and[X](https://x.com/Courtyard_io) is the easiest way to keep up with every update in real-time.


## **Stay Tuned for More Updates on Courtyard’s Most Wanted Event**


Gamers across the globe are preparing to return to Leonida on November 19th. In order to help get them geared up ahead of their arrival, Courtyard’s upcoming[Most Wanted event](https://courtyard.io/events/courtyard-most-wanted) has plenty of surprises for all types of collectors.


We’ll be back with the full story soon. In the meantime, turn on Flash FM, Fever 105, Radio-X, and more, and get ready for a wild ride.
